purpose: Find no-purchase source capabilities and explicitly list uncovered AISDI requirements; not economic-data acquisition acceptance
search_conclusion: Free source candidates support partial research, not full original-spec/global/2024-2026/PIT coverage. Every remaining gap is explicit. No universal impossibility claim.

sources.name: SEC EDGAR
sources.capability: Standard company facts; original filings and accession metadata
sources.limitations: Companyfacts excludes custom/dimensional segmentation; AI-specific interpretation needs original filing review. Current captures are not PIT certification.
sources.history: Multi-year original filings; exact metric/period coverage must be checked per issuer

sources.name: US company official IR
sources.capability: Revenue, cloud segments, cash flows, leases, debt, contractual notes
sources.limitations: AI/total and cash/lease Capex differ. No complete global training/inference split or obligation double-count audit.
sources.history: Annual/quarterly archive; metric definitions change

sources.name: NVIDIA official reports
sources.capability: Data-center revenue, financials, supply commitments, disclosed guarantees
sources.limitations: Revenue/purchase obligations are not GPU order units, powered-on installed units, or customer utilization.
sources.history: Quarterly/annual filings; SKU units generally not disclosed

sources.name: Micron and SK hynix official results
sources.capability: Memory revenue, qualification/shipment statements, reported bit growth
sources.limitations: Reported growth or sold-out statements do not give complete absolute HBM bits, yields, utilization or customer orders.
sources.history: Quarterly releases with changing HBM detail; not a consistent 36-month absolute series

sources.name: Samsung/SK hynix financial disclosure
sources.capability: Financial statements, memory mix and qualitative supply milestones
sources.limitations: K-IFRS/KRW; AI/HBM and qualified capacity not fully separated.
sources.history: Public annual/quarterly archives including 2024/2025

sources.name: TSMC monthly revenue
sources.capability: Consolidated monthly revenue; quarterly financials available separately
sources.limitations: NTD; total foundry revenue not HBM bits or optical supply.
sources.history: Historical monthly archive; issuer-wide rather than AI-specific

sources.name: Coherent/Lumentum official disclosure
sources.capability: Cloud/networking financials and reported order/shipments events
sources.limitations: 800G/1.6T units, yields, qualification, backlog split and book-to-bill often absent; growth commentary not numeric level.
sources.history: Annual/quarterly, occasional technical announcements

sources.name: CNINFO official issuer filings
sources.capability: Chinese supplier financials, shipment milestones, capacity project disclosures
sources.limitations: PDF/text extraction and filing date review required; product capacity announcements not qualified shipments. CNY to USD needs explicit FX source.
sources.history: Annual/semiannual/quarterly original documents; no complete product-level weekly history

sources.name: CoreWeave and DC operators official results
sources.capability: Active vs contracted power, revenue backlog, leases and financial statements
sources.limitations: Active/available/contracted/revenue-generating MW differ; published-company sample only, not global AI fleet. Digital Realty occupancy not GPU utilization.
sources.history: Quarterly; recent public issuer history may be shorter than 12 quarters

sources.name: Nebius official shareholder letter
sources.capability: Explicit active power definition and contracted sites
sources.limitations: Plans and connected power not equivalent to active monetized capacity; issuer sample not global fleet.
sources.history: Quarterly, recent AI business history

sources.name: Epoch AI public datasets
sources.capability: Training compute estimates, model records; GPU cluster dataset separately downloadable
sources.limitations: Estimated/retrospective, incomplete global coverage, planned records included. Does not prove training spend/utilization or revenue-generating capacity.
sources.history: Event records across years; revision/current snapshot not historical available_timestamp

sources.name: Meta Llama model card
sources.capability: Reported GPU hours for individual completed training runs
sources.limitations: One release/run; not continuous industry demand, cancelled-run census or current cluster utilization.
sources.history: Release-specific retrospective disclosure

sources.name: OpenRouter model catalogue
sources.capability: Current input/output API list prices, context windows, model identifiers
sources.limitations: Tokenization, cache/reasoning discounts and different providers; published price is not realized revenue or serving production cost.
sources.history: Current snapshot only; record from now for history

sources.name: OpenRouter model endpoints
sources.capability: Endpoint prices/status/uptime and latency/throughput fields
sources.limitations: Fields can be null; sampled traffic and short rolling windows, not guaranteed limits or fleet TPS. One model success not all-model coverage.
sources.history: Current rolling 5m/30m/1d snapshots; no 2024 full history certified

sources.name: OpenRouter platform usage
sources.capability: Daily platform tokens and selected public app total_requests; CC BY4.0 aggregate data
sources.limitations: Valid own OpenRouter key required for JSON. No direct-provider/private traffic, no successful task census, no input/output split from total_tokens alone.
sources.history: Documented start 2025-01-01; max366 days/request; revisions and current snapshots require archival

sources.name: Artificial Analysis basic API
sources.capability: Benchmark scores, price, median output TPS and TTFT; 1000 requests/day per free docs
sources.limitations: Free benchmark API differs from paid comprehensive API. Not global installed capacity, realized cost or exact p95 task latency; version/quality controls required.
sources.history: Free current snapshot history not documented; no 2024 weekly archive verified

sources.name: Hugging Face public Hub metadata
sources.capability: Public model metadata, revisions, model cards and license tags
sources.limitations: Model repository count not deployment count. Gated/license restrictions; inference execution may cost money.
sources.history: Repository revision history, not global endpoint uptime/deployment history

sources.name: MLCommons inference results
sources.capability: System-specific accuracy/throughput benchmark comparison
sources.limitations: Hardware/model/precision/batch constraints; not fleet deployment, economic demand or accessible API capacity.

sources.name: Official service status pages
sources.capability: Service components and dated incident history; Claude official status also available
sources.limitations: Self-reported aggregate status, not customer/model/region-specific SLA or task success; summary not an uptime series.

sources.capability: Selected WAU/seats; Anthropic official ARR/run-rate announcements

sources.name: EIA open data/API/bulk
sources.capability: US generation/capacity, demand and electricity pricing by dataset
sources.limitations: Regional all-industry data, not AI allocation or data-center commissioning. MW versus MWh and frequency must be fixed.

sources.limitations: Power-generation queues not AI load queues; PPA cohort not individual AI contract; planned queue cannot count as effective supply.

sources.name: PJM operational/public data
sources.capability: Load and load forecast; grid planning context
sources.limitations: Forecast and regional electricity demand not energized AI project MW or project commissioning. Machine API rights/keys not verified.

sources.name: FERC utility forms
sources.capability: Annual/quarterly utility operating and financial disclosures
sources.limitations: Not a global AI-site capacity registry or contract-level power available to AI.

sources.capability: Public reported bond trade/yield information for selected issuers
sources.limitations: Issuer/bond coverage and liquidity vary; full historic files require fees/agreement; no free CDS curve proven.

sources.name: US Treasury interest-rate feeds
sources.capability: Official daily Treasury par yields as a credit benchmark
sources.limitations: Par yield not zero yield or a matched issuer OAS; require bond/maturity/callability assumptions.
sources.history: Daily par curve feed historical archive, not AI issuer credit

sources.name: Optional FRED ICE OAS
sources.capability: Broad IG OAS, optional macro funding context
sources.limitations: Broad IG, not AI issuer credit. ICE prohibits publication/distribution without prior permission. FRED remains optional and not newly enabled.
sources.history: From April 2026 limited to rolling 3 years; original-provider and vintage restrictions

sources.name: Federal Reserve H.10 FX
sources.capability: Daily bilateral exchange rates for supported currencies
sources.limitations: Previous business-week observations released following Monday 16:15 (holiday shifts); unavailable at earlier observation cutoff. Freeze period-average vs balance-date conversion.
sources.history: Historical releases; verify currency, units and release dates
